purpose: Provide reusable infrastructure and patterns for products governed by Intent, Contracts, quality and Evidence.
scope: Reusable product infrastructure and operating-model templates; consumer business state and targets remain outside the kit.
principles: Every change is an explicit delta; unmentioned behavior, contracts, data and configuration are preserved by default
Every interface change reviews the Design System and records reuse, extension, creation, local-only or not-applicable before implementation
Operational risk evolves with measured exposure
Consumer targets stay with the consumer
Budgets and alerts are not hard limits
Unknown, stale or unavailable is not passed
